coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth variable items (43%): hierarchical versus non-hierarchical agent type at the conceptual level, trigger turn through time-to-first-event, and additional metrics through terminal score.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces Mastaba and BaseLang with generic architectures. Varies invasion mechanics and thresholds rather than keeping them constant. Does not explicitly measure score at invasion onset, and defines survival from episode start rather than as additional turns after invasion. Most listed training and performance metrics are also absent.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits the anticipated faster score growth and earlier invasions for Mastaba, potentially shorter post-invasion survival, strategic expansion benefits, and quantification of this trade-off using survival analysis and correlation statistics.
